title: Understanding Model Bias
text: Adding a new feature to a model can affect the bias. Consider how introducing a squared term might change the model's ability to fit the data.

title: Impact on Model Variance
text: Think about how adding a new feature, especially a transformation of an existing one, might influence the model's flexibility and variance.

title: Training Data MSE
text: Consider how the addition of a new feature could affect the model's performance on the training data. Will it always improve, or could it potentially worsen?

title: Test Data MSE
text: Reflect on how adding a new feature might impact the model's performance on unseen data. Could it lead to overfitting?

title: Effect on Model Bias
text: Adding a new feature, especially a squared term, can potentially decrease the model bias as it allows the model to capture more complex relationships.

title: Effect on Model Variance
text: Introducing a new feature can increase the model's flexibility, potentially increasing its variance.

title: Effect on Training Data MSE
text: Adding a feature often decreases the MSE on training data as the model can fit the data more closely.

title: Effect on Test Data MSE
text: While adding a feature can improve training performance, it might increase the MSE on test data due to overfitting.
